text.p: National grocery retailer Woolworths Ltd said on Monday it planned to open 15 new supermarkets and six new Big W discount variety stores each year as part of its growth strategy.

The company, which earlier said it achieved an 8.62 percent rise in first half net profit to A$147.5 million, said in notes accompanying its profit statement that it opened 29 supermarkets in the six months to January 5 and four Big W stores.
Total stores in the latest period were 1,080.
It said other aspects of the growth strategy would include ongoing store refurbishment and the implementations of its petrol retailing strategy.

One of the impacts of this strategy would be an increase in debt over the next two years due to an increase in cash outlay for dividends and additional capital spending on warehouses, petrol canopies, and the wholesale/food service.
